mechanism_card.hypothesis: Adding 10% next-ranked (mid-distance footwall basement flexure) dots tests whether marginal kernel credit exceeds 0.059 threshold
mechanism_card.mechanism: Each new dot adds 0.2*(1-m_self) FP penalty but also T = p(k) kernel credit; DTI rises only if T >0.2*DTI~0.056 for isolated truth, lower for linear truth
mechanism_card.non_fault_mimic: Extensional terrace risers and lithologic contacts that produce coincident RTP/gravity edges but lack geothermal plumbing; adding them inflates FP
mechanism_card.falsifier: If live DTI rises >0.01, our ranking under-represents blind geothermal corridors that lie at intermediate distances from known faults
